name: Exp_AFL_WinnerSign
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom AFL_WinnerSign indicator, which identifies momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options. The EA includes both entry and exit logic driven by the same indicator, supporting position reversal or independent close signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AFL_WinnerSign指标的信号进行交易，该指标识别基于动量的买卖信号。在上升信号时开多单，下降信号时开空单，具有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。EA包含由同一指标驱动的入场和出场逻辑，支持仓位反转或独立平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用AFL_WinnerSign指标识别动量方向并顺势交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（UpValue）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时，开多单并平空单；当缓冲区0（DnValue）产生有效信号时，开空单并平多单。出场条件分为两类：一是反向信号出场（指标发出反向信号时平仓），二是止损/止盈出场（默认SL=1000点，TP=2000点）。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金等5种资金管理方式。策略还包含一个回溯逻辑：当开仓和平仓同时启用但当前K线未产生平仓信号时，会向前遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号以决定是否平仓。该EA默认在H6周期运行，使用可配置的平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA等）和多种应用价格类型。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the AFL_WinnerSign indicator to identify momentum direction and trade with the trend. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 1 (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE signal on the specified signal bar, a buy position is opened and sell positions are closed; when buffer 0 (DnValue) produces a valid signal, a sell position is opened and buy positions are closed. Exit conditions come in two types: first, reverse-signal exits where the indicator issues an opposite signal triggering closure; second, stop loss/take profit exits with default SL=1000 points and TP=2000 points. Position sizing leverages TradeAlgorithms.mqh with five money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, loss-based balance, and loss-based free margin. The strategy also includes a lookback logic: when both open and close flags are enabled but no close signal appears on the current bar, the EA scans forward through historical bars to find the nearest reverse signal for closure decisions. The EA defaults to H6 timeframe and supports configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA etc.) with multiple applied price types.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/余额百分比/可用保证金等）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode (fixed lot/balance %/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已收盘K线）
parameters.description_en: Signal bar index (0=current bar, 1=previous closed bar)

pros: 支持多种资金管理模式（固定手数、余额百分比等），灵活适应不同风险偏好
买卖开仓和平仓可独立开关配置，允许只做单边或只做信号提示
默认使用SignalBar=1（已收盘K线），避免未收盘K线信号反复变化导致的误交易
包含NewBar检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
止损止盈参数可配置，默认TP大于SL（2:1盈亏比），符合正向期望交易原则
pros_en: Supports multiple money management modes (fixed lot, balance percentage, etc.) for flexible risk preference adaptation
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, allowing one-direction-only trading or signal-only mode
Defaults to SignalBar=1 (closed bar), preventing repeated false signals from unclosed bars
Includes NewBar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate entries within the same bar
Configurable SL/TP with default TP>SL (2:1 reward-risk ratio), aligning with positive expectancy trading principles
cons: 依赖自定义指标AFL_WinnerSign，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行，且指标逻辑不透明
回溯平仓逻辑中遍历所有历史K线（for循环无上界优化），在长历史数据下可能导致性能问题
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差品种上可能导致滑点过大或无效成交
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在不同信号周期内重复开仓
止损1000点较大，在某些品种上可能承受过大浮亏
cons_en: Depends on custom AFL_WinnerSign indicator - if the indicator file is missing the EA fails, and indicator logic is opaque
Lookback close logic iterates all historical bars without upper bound optimization, potentially causing performance issues on long history data
No spread filter mechanism, which may cause excessive slippage or invalid fills on high-spread instruments
No position existence check before opening, potentially leading to duplicate positions across signal periods
Stop loss of 1000 points is large and may result in significant floating losses on certain instruments
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
为回溯平仓循环增加最大回溯K线数限制，防止遍历过多历史数据导致性能下降
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，避免在高点差或低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add position existence check before opening to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Add a maximum lookback bar limit to the closure scanning loop to prevent excessive historical data traversal
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-spread or low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 回溯平仓循环无上界限制，极端情况下可能遍历大量历史K线导致延迟
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
依赖外部自定义指标文件，指标缺失时EA直接初始化失败
risk_points_en: Lookback close loop has no upper bound, potentially traversing massive historical bars causing delays in extreme cases
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Depends on external custom indicator file - EA initialization fails outright if indicator is missing
